attributes.name: AutoPilot
attributes.description: Is autopilot currently on or not?

attributes.name: NeutralBallastLevel
attributes.description: How full the ballast tanks should be when the submarine is not being steered upwards/downwards. Can be used to compensate if the ballast tanks are too large/small relative to the size of the submarine.

attributes.name: DockingAssistThreshold
attributes.description: How close the docking port has to be to another docking port for the docking mode to become active.

components.notes: 表头为 4 列：Attribute | Type | Default value | Description。示例里 <Steering> 直接子元素含 GuiFrame / StatusEffect / 若干 Indicator / poweronsound。该页无用途说明句；继承 Powered、ItemComponent。

attributes.name: BarrelPos
attributes.description: The position of the barrel relative to the upper left corner of the base sprite (in pixels).

attributes.name: FiringOffset
attributes.description: The projectile launching location relative to transformed barrel position (in pixels).

attributes.name: AlternatingFiringOffset
attributes.description: If enabled, the firing offset will alternate from left to right (i.e. flipping the x-component of the offset each shot.)

attributes.name: LaunchImpulse
attributes.description: The impulse applied to the physics body of the projectile (the higher the impulse, the faster the projectiles are launched).

attributes.name: DamageMultiplier
attributes.description: Multiplies the damage the turret deals by this amount.

attributes.name: ProjectileCount
attributes.description: How many projectiles the weapon launches when fired once.

attributes.name: LaunchWithoutProjectile
attributes.description: Can the turret be fired without projectiles (causing it just to execute the OnUse effects and the firing animation without actually firing anything).

attributes.name: Spread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the firing angle of the projectiles (in degrees).

attributes.name: FiringRotationSpeedModifier
attributes.description: How fast the turret can rotate while firing (for charged weapons).

attributes.name: SingleChargedShot
attributes.description: Whether the turret should always charge-up fully to shoot.

attributes.name: BaseRotation
attributes.description: The angle of the turret's base in degrees.

attributes.name: AIRange
attributes.description: How close to a target the turret has to be for an AI character to fire it.

attributes.name: MaxAngleOffset
attributes.description: How much off the turret can be from the target for the AI to shoot. In degrees.

attributes.name: AICurrentTargetPriorityMultiplier
attributes.description: How much does the AI prefer currently selected targets over new targets closer to the turret.

attributes.name: MaxActiveProjectiles
attributes.description: The turret won't fire additional projectiles if the number of previously fired, still active projectiles reaches this limit. If set to -1, there is no limit to the number of projectiles.

attributes.name: MaxChargeTime
attributes.description: The time required for a charge-type turret to charge up before able to fire.

attributes.name: Reload
attributes.description: The period of time the user has to wait between shots.

attributes.name: ShotsPerBurst
attributes.description: How many projectiles needs to be shot before we add an extra break? Think of the double coilgun.

attributes.name: DelayBetweenBursts
attributes.description: An extra delay between the bursts. Added to the reload.

attributes.name: RetractionDurationMultiplier
attributes.description: Modifies the duration of retraction of the barrell after recoil to get back to the original position after shooting. Reload time affects this too.

attributes.name: RecoilTime
attributes.description: How quickly the recoil moves the barrel after launching.

attributes.name: RetractionDelay
attributes.description: How long the barrell stays in place after the recoil and before retracting back to the original position.

attributes.name: RotationLimits
attributes.description: The range at which the barrel can rotate.

attributes.name: SpringStiffnessLowSkill
attributes.description: How much torque is applied to rotate the barrel when the item is used by a character with insufficient skills to operate it. Higher values make the barrel rotate faster.

attributes.name: SpringStiffnessHighSkill
attributes.description: How much torque is applied to rotate the barrel when the item is used by a character with sufficient skills to operate it. Higher values make the barrel rotate faster.

attributes.name: SpringDampingLowSkill
attributes.description: How much torque is applied to resist the movement of the barrel when the item is used by a character with insufficient skills to operate it. Higher values make the aiming more "snappy", stopping the barrel from swinging around the direction it's being aimed at.

attributes.name: SpringDampingHighSkill
attributes.description: How much torque is applied to resist the movement of the barrel when the item is used by a character with sufficient skills to operate it. Higher values make the aiming more "snappy", stopping the barrel from swinging around the direction it's being aimed at.

attributes.name: RotationSpeedLowSkill
attributes.description: Maximum angular velocity of the barrel when used by a character with insufficient skills to operate it.

attributes.name: RotationSpeedHighSkill
attributes.description: Maximum angular velocity of the barrel when used by a character with sufficient skills to operate it.

attributes.name: HudTint
attributes.description: Optional screen tint color when the item is being operated (R,G,B,A).

attributes.name: AutoOperate
attributes.description: Should the turret operate automatically using AI targeting? Comes with some optional random movement that can be adjusted below.

attributes.name: AllowAutoOperateWithWiring
attributes.description: Can the Auto Operate functionality be enabled using signals to the turret?

attributes.name: RandomAimAmount
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] How much the turret should adjust the aim off the target randomly instead of tracking the target perfectly? In Degrees.

attributes.name: RandomAimMinTime
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] How often the turret should adjust the aim randomly instead of tracking the target perfectly? Minimum wait time, in seconds.

attributes.name: RandomAimMaxTime
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] How often the turret should adjust the aim randomly instead of tracking the target perfectly? Maximum wait time, in seconds.

attributes.name: RandomMovement
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret move randomly while idle?

attributes.name: AimDelay
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret have a delay while targeting targets or always aim prefectly?

attributes.name: TargetCharacters
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret target characters in general?

attributes.name: TargetMonsters
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret target all monsters?

attributes.name: TargetHumans
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret target all humans (or creatures in the same group, like pets)?

attributes.name: TargetSubmarines
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret target other submarines?

attributes.name: TargetItems
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Should the turret target items?

attributes.name: FriendlyTag
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Group or SpeciesName that the AI ignores when the turret is operated automatically.

attributes.name: FriendlyTeamType
attributes.description: [Auto Operate] Team that the turret considers friendly.

attributes.name: ShowChargeIndicator
attributes.description: Should the charge of the connected batteries/supercapacitors be shown at the top of the screen when operating the item.

attributes.name: ShowProjectileIndicator
attributes.description: Should the available ammunition be shown at the top of the screen when operating the item.

attributes.name: RecoilDistance
attributes.description: How far the barrel "recoils back" when the turret is fired (in pixels).

attributes.name: SpinningBarrelDistance
attributes.description: The distance in which the spinning barrels rotate. Only used if spinning barrels are created.

attributes.name: ChargeSoundWindupPitchSlide
attributes.description: Pitch slides from X to Y over the charge time

components.notes: 全批最大属性表（50 项）。属性名 PascalCase 为主，示例里 XML 上写的是小写（如 barrelpos / projectilecount），文档表用 PascalCase —— 两者都能被游戏解析。

attributes.name: LaunchImpulse
attributes.description: The impulse applied to the physics body of the item when it's launched. Higher values make the projectile faster.

attributes.name: ImpulseSpread
attributes.description: The random percentage modifier used to add variance to the launch impulse.

attributes.name: LaunchRotation
attributes.description: The rotation of the item relative to the rotation of the weapon when launched (in degrees).

attributes.name: DoesStick
attributes.description: When set to true, the item can stick to any target it hits.

attributes.name: StickToCharacters
attributes.description: Can the projectile stick to characters.

attributes.name: StickToStructures
attributes.description: Can the projectile stick to walls.

attributes.name: StickToItems
attributes.description: Can the projectile stick to items.

attributes.name: StickToDoors
attributes.description: Can the projectile stick to doors. Caution: may cause issues.

attributes.name: StickToDeflective
attributes.description: Can the item stick even to deflective targets.

attributes.name: LightTargetMassThreshold
attributes.description: Minimum mass of targets to stick to when StickToLightTargets is disabled. Defaults to half of the projectile's mass.

attributes.name: Hitscan
attributes.description: Hitscan projectiles cast a ray forwards and immediately hit whatever the ray hits. It is recommended to use hitscans for very fast-moving projectiles such as bullets, because using extremely fast launch velocities may cause physics glitches.

attributes.name: HitScanCount
attributes.description: How many hitscans should be done when the projectile is launched. Multiple hitscans can be used to simulate weapons that fire multiple projectiles at the same time without having to actually use multiple projectile items, for example shotguns.

attributes.name: MaxTargetsToHit
attributes.description: How many targets the projectile can hit before it stops.

attributes.name: RemoveOnHit
attributes.description: Should the item be deleted when it hits something.

attributes.name: Spread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the launch angle of the projectile (in degrees).

attributes.name: StaticSpread
attributes.description: Override random spread with static spread; projectiles are launched with an equal amount of angle between them. Only applies when firing multiple projectiles.

attributes.name: IgnoreProjectilesWhileActive
attributes.description: Enable only if you want to make the projectile ignore collisions with other projectiles when it's shot. Doesn't have any effect, if the item is not set to be damaged by projectiles.

attributes.name: DamageUser
attributes.description: Can the projectile hit the user? Should generally be disabled, unless the projectile is for example something like shrapnel launched by a projectile impact.

attributes.name: UsableIn
attributes.description: Can the item be used in air, underwater or both.

attributes.name: Force
attributes.description: The force to apply to the user's body.

attributes.name: ApplyToHands
attributes.description: If the item is held in RightHand or LeftHand, apply extra force there

attributes.name: BarrelPos
attributes.description: The position of the barrel as an offset from the item's center (in pixels). Determines where the projectiles spawn.

attributes.name: Reload
attributes.description: How long the user has to wait before they can fire the weapon again (in seconds).

attributes.name: ReloadSkillRequirement
attributes.description: Weapons skill requirement to reload at normal speed.

attributes.name: ReloadNoSkill
attributes.description: Reload time at 0 skill level. Reload time scales with skill level up to the Weapons skill requirement.

attributes.name: HoldTrigger
attributes.description: Tells the AI to hold the trigger down when it uses this weapon

attributes.name: ProjectileCount
attributes.description: How many projectiles the weapon launches when fired once.

attributes.name: Spread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the firing angle of the projectiles when used by a character with sufficient skills to use the weapon (in degrees).

attributes.name: UnskilledSpread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the firing angle of the projectiles when used by a character with insufficient skills to use the weapon (in degrees).

attributes.name: LaunchImpulse
attributes.description: The impulse applied to the physics body of the projectile (the higher the impulse, the faster the projectiles are launched). Sum of weapon + projectile.

attributes.name: Penetration
attributes.description: Percentage of damage mitigation ignored when hitting armored body parts (deflecting limbs). Sum of weapon + projectile.

attributes.name: WeaponDamageModifier
attributes.description: Weapon's damage modifier

attributes.name: MaxChargeTime
attributes.description: The time required for a charge-type turret to charge up before able to fire.

attributes.name: DualWieldReloadTimePenaltyMultiplier
attributes.description: Penalty multiplier to reload time when dual-wielding.

attributes.name: DualWieldAccuracyPenalty
attributes.description: Additive penalty to accuracy (spread angle) when dual-wielding.

attributes.name: ChargeSoundWindupPitchSlide
attributes.description: Pitch slides from X to Y over the charge time

attributes.name: CrossHairScale
attributes.description: The scale of the crosshair sprite (if there is one).

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: The distance at which the item can spray walls.

attributes.name: SprayStrength
attributes.description: How fast the item changes the color of the walls.

components.notes: <PaintColors> 内还有 <PaintColor>。继承 RangedWeapon、ItemComponent 的属性。

attributes.name: MaxOutputLength
attributes.description: The maximum length of the output string. Warning: Large values can lead to large memory usage or networking issues.

attributes.name: Output
attributes.description: The signal this item outputs when the received signal matches the regular expression.

attributes.name: UseCaptureGroup
attributes.description: Should the component output a value of a capture group instead of a constant signal.

attributes.name: OutputEmptyCaptureGroup
attributes.description: Should the component output the value of a capture group even if it's empty?

attributes.name: FalseOutput
attributes.description: The signal this item outputs when the received signal does not match the regular expression.

attributes.name: ContinuousOutput
attributes.description: Should the component keep sending the output even after it stops receiving a signal, or only send an output when it receives a signal.

attributes.name: Expression
attributes.description: The regular expression used to check the incoming signals.

attributes.name: Target
attributes.description: Tag or identifier of the item that should be controlled.

components.notes: 示例中为自闭合标签。

attributes.name: DeteriorationSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the condition of the item deteriorates per second.

attributes.name: MinDeteriorationDelay
attributes.description: Minimum initial delay before the item starts to deteriorate.

attributes.name: MaxDeteriorationDelay
attributes.description: Maximum initial delay before the item starts to deteriorate.

attributes.name: MinDeteriorationCondition
attributes.description: The item won't deteriorate spontaneously if the condition is below this value. For example, if set to 10, the condition will spontaneously drop to 10 and then stop dropping (unless the item is damaged further by external factors). Percentages of max condition.

attributes.name: MinSabotageCondition
attributes.description: How low a traitor must get the item's condition for it to start breaking down.

attributes.name: SabotageDeteriorationDuration
attributes.description: How long will the item spontaneously deteriorate after being sabotaged.

attributes.name: RepairThreshold
attributes.description: The condition of the item has to be below this for it to become repairable. Percentages of max condition.

attributes.name: MaxStressDeteriorationMultiplier
attributes.description: How much faster the device can deteriorate when under stress (e.g. when operating at full speed/power).

attributes.name: StressDeteriorationThreshold
attributes.description: At what speed/power must the device be operating at to be considered "under stress".

attributes.name: StressDeteriorationIncreaseSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the deterioration speed increases when under stress.

attributes.name: StressDeteriorationDecreaseSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the deterioration speed decreases when not under stress.

attributes.name: FixDurationLowSkill
attributes.description: The amount of time it takes to fix the item with insufficient skill levels.

attributes.name: FixDurationHighSkill
attributes.description: The amount of time it takes to fix the item with sufficient skill levels.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: An optional description of the needed repairs displayed in the repair interface.

attributes.name: UsableIn
attributes.description: Can the item be used in air, water or both.

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: The distance at which the item can repair targets.

attributes.name: Spread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the firing angle when used by a character with sufficient skills to use the tool (in degrees).

attributes.name: UnskilledSpread
attributes.description: Random spread applied to the firing angle when used by a character with insufficient skills to use the tool (in degrees).

attributes.name: StructureFixAmount
attributes.description: How many units of damage the item removes from structures per second.

attributes.name: FireDamage
attributes.description: How much damage is applied to ballast flora.

attributes.name: LevelWallFixAmount
attributes.description: How many units of damage the item removes from destructible level walls per second.

attributes.name: ExtinguishAmount
attributes.description: How much the item decreases the size of fires per second.

attributes.name: WaterAmount
attributes.description: How much water the item provides to planters per second.

attributes.name: BarrelPos
attributes.description: The position of the barrel as an offset from the item's center (in pixels).

attributes.name: RepairThroughWalls
attributes.description: Can the item repair things through walls.

attributes.name: RepairMultiple
attributes.description: Can the item repair multiple things at once, or will it only affect the first thing the ray from the barrel hits.

attributes.name: RepairMultipleWalls
attributes.description: Can the item repair multiple walls at once? Only relevant if RepairMultiple is true.

attributes.name: RepairThroughHoles
attributes.description: Can the item repair things through holes in walls.

attributes.name: MaxOverlappingWallDist
attributes.description: How far two walls need to not be considered overlapping and to stop the ray.

attributes.name: DeattachSpeed
attributes.description: How fast the tool detaches level resources (e.g. minerals). Acts as a multiplier on the speed: with a value of 2, detaching an item whose DeattachDuration is set to 30 seconds would take 15 seconds.

attributes.name: HitItems
attributes.description: Can the item hit doors.

attributes.name: HitBrokenDoors
attributes.description: Can the item hit broken doors.

attributes.name: IgnoreCharacters
attributes.description: Should the tool ignore characters? Enabled e.g. for fire extinguisher.

attributes.name: FireProbability
attributes.description: The probability of starting a fire somewhere along the ray fired from the barrel (for example, 0.1 = 10% chance to start a fire during a second of use).

attributes.name: TargetForce
attributes.description: Force applied to the entity the ray hits.

attributes.name: BarrelRotation
attributes.description: Rotation of the barrel in degrees.

attributes.name: ProjectilePullForce
attributes.description: How much force is applied to pull the projectile the rope is attached to.

attributes.name: TargetPullForce
attributes.description: How much force is applied to pull the target the rope is attached to.

attributes.name: SourcePullForce
attributes.description: How much force is applied to pull the source the rope is attached to.

attributes.name: MaxLength
attributes.description: How far the source item can be from the projectile until the rope breaks.

attributes.name: MinPullDistance
attributes.description: At which distance the user stops pulling the target?

attributes.name: MaxAngle
attributes.description: The maximum angle from the source to the target until the rope breaks.

attributes.name: SnapOnCollision
attributes.description: Should the rope snap when it collides with a structure/submarine (if not, it will just go through it).

attributes.name: SnapWhenNotAimed
attributes.description: Should the rope snap when the character drops the aim?

attributes.name: SnapWhenWeaponFiredAgain
attributes.description: Should the rope snap when the weapon it was fired from is fired again? I.e. can there be multiple ropes coming from the weapon at the same time?

attributes.name: BarrelLengthMultiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier for the length of the barrel when determining where the rope should start from.

attributes.name: TargetMinMass
attributes.description: How much mass is required for the target to pull the source towards it. Static and kinematic targets are always treated heavy enough.

attributes.name: IncreaseForceForEscapingTargets
attributes.description: Should the force be dynamically adjusted to make it more difficult for targets to escape the pull?

attributes.name: ReelSoundPitchSlide
attributes.description: When reeling in, the pitch slides from X to Y, depending on the length of the rope.

attributes.name: ScanDuration
attributes.description: How long it takes for the scan to be completed.

attributes.name: ScanTimer
attributes.description: How far along the scan is. When the timer goes above ScanDuration, the scan is completed.

attributes.name: ScanRadius
attributes.description: How far the scanner can be from the target for the scan to be successful.

attributes.name: AlwaysDisplayProgressBar
attributes.description: Should the progress bar always be displayed when the item has been attached.

attributes.name: MaxOutputLength
attributes.description: The maximum length of the output strings. Warning: Large values can lead to large memory usage or networking issues.

attributes.name: Output
attributes.description: The signal this item outputs when the received signal matches the target signal.

attributes.name: FalseOutput
attributes.description: The signal this item outputs when the received signal does not match the target signal.

attributes.name: TargetSignal
attributes.description: The value to compare the received signals against.

attributes.name: WelcomeMessage
attributes.description: Message to be displayed on the terminal display when it is first opened.

attributes.name: UseMonospaceFont
attributes.description: The terminal will use a monospace font if this box is ticked.

attributes.name: TextColor
attributes.description: Color of the terminal text.

attributes.name: Force
attributes.description: The maximum amount of force applied to the triggering entitites.

attributes.name: DirectionalForce
attributes.description: The maximum amount of directional force applied to the triggering entitites.

attributes.name: RelativeDirectionalForce
attributes.description: If true, DirectionalForce is relative to the angle between the target and the item, Similar to Force. If false, it always pushes in the same direction, with respect to the item's rotation.

attributes.name: VerticalForce
attributes.description: If false, no vertical force will be applied.

attributes.name: HorizontalForce
attributes.description: If false, no horizontal force will be applied.

attributes.name: DistanceBasedForce
attributes.description: Determines if the force gets higher the closer the triggerer is to the center of the trigger.

attributes.name: ForceFluctuation
attributes.description: Determines if the force fluctuates over time or if it stays constant.

attributes.name: ForceFluctuationStrength
attributes.description: How much the fluctuation affects the force. 1 is the maximum fluctuation, 0 is no fluctuation.

attributes.name: ForceFluctuationFrequency
attributes.description: How fast (cycles per second) the force fluctuates.

attributes.name: ForceFluctuationInterval
attributes.description: How often (in seconds) the force fluctuation is calculated.

attributes.name: TeamID
attributes.description: WiFi components can only communicate with components that have the same Team ID.

attributes.name: Range
attributes.description: How close the recipient has to be to receive a signal from this WiFi component.

attributes.name: Channel
attributes.description: WiFi components can only communicate with components that use the same channel.

attributes.name: AllowCrossTeamCommunication
attributes.description: Can the component communicate with wifi components in another team's submarine (e.g. enemy sub in Combat missions, respawn shuttle). Needs to be enabled on both the component transmitting the signal and the component receiving it.

attributes.name: LinkToChat
attributes.description: If enabled, any signals received from another chat-linked wifi component are displayed as chat messages in the chatbox of the player holding the item.

attributes.name: MinChatMessageInterval
attributes.description: How many seconds have to pass between signals for a message to be displayed in the chatbox. Setting this to a very low value is not recommended, because it may cause an excessive amount of chat messages to be created if there are chat-linked wifi components that transmit a continuous signal.

attributes.name: DiscardDuplicateChatMessages
attributes.description: If set to true, the component will only create chat messages when the received signal changes.
